text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make code easier to read and understand, so developers can find and fix problems more quickly. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when teams take shortcuts to finish tasks fast. By cleaning up messy code, teams can work more efficiently in the future. However, it is important to remember that refactoring should never change how the program behaves. Tests help make sure the software still works correctly after the code has been improved.
